[Rating: 5/10] [b][i]LINKX[/i][/b] is a perfectly fine abstract strategy game, giving players the experience it promises. I've played a half-dozen times, and it's fine. I'd just prefer something else.

[Rating: 6/10] Tetris meets Connect Four. Be the first to connect both sides (or the top and bottom) with pieces of your color. As someone else noted, the game probably should start with the "pie" rule, as the first player appears to have an advantage.

[Rating: 6/10] Relaxing, but somewhat quick game. A two-out-of-three game is almost necessary for the game to go on any period of time.

[Rating: 6/10] Crosby Very quick head-to-heas so you can play repeatedly. Much better than Connect 4 type games.

[Rating: 7/10] [b][url=https://boardgamegeek.com/video/566253/linkx/linkx-review-you-are-the-weakest-linkx]Dice Tower Reviews: LINKX [/url][/b]

[Rating: 7/10] Interesting combination of Connection game, Tetris and 4 gewinnt. Much more interesting than expected at a first glance.

[Rating: 7/10] Ein abstraktes Spiel, das man in 2 Minuten erklärt und in 10 Minuten spielt: reizt mich schonmal sehr. Fühlt sich dabei einfach und clever an, hat mir persönlich für ein paar Runden Spaß gemacht und lässt für mich nur Zweifel in der langfristigen Bewertungen (bei 10+ Partien). So aber erstmal cool.
